confess_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_2.text: There's one last place I want to show you.

confess_seo_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_3.text: *The rooftop. The sunset is painting the school in gold. The very same place I first came on Day 1.*

confess_seo_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_4.text: *Seoyeon is leaning against the railing. The wind catches her hair. — She tucks it back with her pinky. That habit.*

confess_seo_choice.name: {name}
confess_seo_choice.text: *My fingertips are cold. There's no wind. — I want to be the only one who knows what's behind her perfect mask.*

confess_seo_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_1.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The wind whips through her hair.*

confess_seo_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_2.text: *My heart feels like it's going to burst out of my chest. — It's okay. This time.*

confess_seo_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_3.text: *I remember the words I couldn't say at my old school. I replayed it hundreds of times -- 'what if I had said it then.' -- This time, I'll confess.*

confess_seo_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_4.text: Seoyeon. You smile perfectly. Always. But -- that 0.5 seconds when you stop smiling keeps nagging at me.

confess_seo_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_5.text: *The words are a mess. I didn't prepare any of this, but I can't stop.*

confess_seo_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_6.text: That was the real you, Seoyeon. That's the you I like.

confess_seo_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_8.text: *Seoyeon says nothing. Her lips are trembling. Not the student council president -- just a girl, standing there.*

confess_seo_yes_10.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_10.text: ...Since you said 'I'm honored' at the school gate.

confess_seo_yes_11.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_11.text: -- You have no idea how long I've been holding that in.

confess_seo_yes_12.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_12.text: *Seoyeon holds out her pinky. The same pinky I saw on Day 1. -- Back then I thought it was just a habit, but this is Seoyeon's way of making a promise.*

confess_seo_no_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_2.text: *I said the same thing on Day 1. Back then I meant it. Now it's just running away.*

confess_seo_no_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_3.text: *Seoyeon smiles. A practiced smile. -- She turns and walks away. On the third step, she stops.*

confess_seo_no_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_4.text: ...Next time you come here, have something else to say.

confess_yuna_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_1.text: *The date is winding down. Yuna stops walking.*

confess_yuna_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3.text: *The library annex. A secret reading nook. Sunset seeps through the window. The very same place I first came on Day 2.*

confess_yuna_4.name: {name}
confess_yuna_4.text: *Yuna is sitting on the sofa, looking at me. As if she'd been waiting.*

confess_yuna_choice.name: {name}
confess_yuna_choice.text: *My breathing has shortened. The room feels smaller. If I don't say it now — I don't think I'll ever have this courage again.*
choices: Yuna. Let me ask you one thing.

confess_yuna_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3.text: Yuna. At first I thought your silence was a wall. But it wasn't.

confess_yuna_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_4.text: *In front of Yuna, I don't need a long speech. She's the kind of person who reads between the lines.*

confess_yuna_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_5.text: You were the kind of person who sits beside someone instead of speaking. That silence was warmer than anyone's words.

confess_yuna_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_8.text: *Yuna's blank expression cracks. Her languid voice disappears, replaced by the tiniest -- almost inaudible -- whisper. She grips her sleeve tight.*

confess_yuna_no_2.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_2.text: *Yuna reads between the lines. She'll know these words are just running away.*

confess_yuna_no_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_3.text: *Yuna picks up a book. She's looking at the cover, but she's not reading.*

confess_dain_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_1.text: *The date is winding down. Dain runs toward the school.*

confess_dain_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_3.text: *The gym. Empty. Sunset spills through the windows onto the court. The very same place we first came together on Day 1.*

confess_dain_4.name: {name}
confess_dain_4.text: *Dain is holding a ball. Casually. — But her fingers are white. She's gripping it tight.*

confess_dain_choice.name: {name}
confess_dain_choice.text: *The gym floor seems to sway. If I don't say it now — I don't think I'll ever have this courage again.*
choices: You know if you run, I'll chase you. So just stay and hear me out.

confess_dain_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3.text: Dain. I — I have something to tell you.

confess_dain_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_4.text: *It's not rock-paper-scissors, it's not a game. But this is everything to me.*

confess_dain_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_5.text: That's why I keep finding myself going to you.

confess_dain_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8.text: *Dain is frozen. Her energy is gone. -- Then her eyes slowly fill up. She buries her face in both hands. The blush has spread all the way to the back of her neck.*

confess_dain_yes_9.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_9.text: ...Wait. I can't breathe -- I think I'm going to cry -- why am I crying, I'm happy --

confess_dain_yes_10.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_10.text: I like you too. So much.

confess_dain_no_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_2.text: *I can set a ball for her, but I can't say three words. Pathetic.*

confess_dain_no_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_3.text: *Dain bounces a volleyball. Once. Twice. -- On the third bounce, she stops.*

confess_yuna_3b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3b.text: *The library annex. Sunset seeps through the windows. A place that became familiar in just a few days.*

confess_seo_3b.name: {name}
confess_seo_3b.text: *The rooftop. The sunset paints the school. A place that became familiar in just a few days.*

confess_dain_3b.name: {name}
confess_dain_3b.text: *The gym. Empty. Sunset seeps through the windows onto the court. A place where countless memories piled up in just a few days.*

confess_seo_4_ins.name: {name}
confess_seo_4_ins.text: *The words I couldn't say at my old school surface. This time, I'll confess.*

confess_yuna_yes_3_ins.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3_ins.text: You were the person who sat beside me instead of saying anything.

confess_yuna_yes_6_ins.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6_ins.text: *I just said the longest sentence in this room. In Yuna's domain.*

confess_yuna_yes_9_ins.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_9_ins.text: *This time. Someone left before. Yuna is reopening that wound, and still holding onto me.*

confess_yuna_no_4_ins.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_4_ins.text: *Three steps away, I looked back. Yuna was watching me too, over the top of her book.*

confess_dain_yes_3_ins.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3_ins.text: When your eyes aren't on me — it gets hard to breathe.

confess_dain_yes_8_ins.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8_ins.text: *She covers her face with both hands. Through the gaps between her fingers, red cheeks are visible.*

confess_dain_yes_9_ins.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_9_ins.text: *She lowers her hands and smiles. Tears are running down her face.*

confess_dain_yes_10_ins.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_10_ins.text: *'A lot.' — Dain is always like this. Short and honest. That's why it's convincing.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins3.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins3.text: *Weekend, early morning. On the way to a café, I pass by the school — there's a light on in an empty classroom.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins4.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins4.text: *The Homeroom Teacher is standing by the window. Holding a stack of manuscript pages. Morning sunlight colors the paper.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins7.name: Homeroom Teacher
confess_dain_no_4_ins7.text: I never called you. *Pausing* ...But I knew you'd come.

confess_dain_no_4_ins8.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins8.text: *She's the kind of person who waits without calling. That's also why the manuscript stayed in a drawer for seven years.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins9.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins9.text: *She holds out the manuscript. A title is written on the cover. One I've never seen before.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins10.name: Homeroom Teacher
confess_dain_no_4_ins10.text: I wanted to show the last chapter... to my first reader.

confess_dain_no_4_ins12.name: Homeroom Teacher
confess_dain_no_4_ins12.text: Seven years. Three to write it, four to finish it.

confess_dain_no_4_ins13.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins13.text: *Four years to finish. Starting is easier than ending for her. Writing and feelings alike.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins14.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins14.text: *I take the manuscript. Start reading. The teacher looks out the window. Morning light. Her fingertips tremble faintly.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins15.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins15.text: *While I read, she doesn't say a word. Just stares out the window. But in the glass reflection, her eyes are on me.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins16.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins16.text: *The last chapter. It ends with a single sentence. Reading that sentence, I think I understand why this manuscript took seven years.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins18.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins18.text: *The tension leaves her shoulders. Very slowly.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins21.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins21.text: *Her voice cracked on the second yeah. The first reader's first impression. The one word she waited seven years to hear.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins23.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins23.text: *Weekend morning. Heading to the nurse's office out of habit. When did this become a habit.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins24.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins24.text: *I open the door. The School Nurse is sitting in her chair. White coat. But something's different today. The playfulness is gone.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins26.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins26.text: *Oh, you're here is half a tone lower than usual. You have to read this person's feelings through tone.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins28.name: School Nurse
confess_dain_no_4_ins28.text: Session, huh... *Turning her chair* Right. Last session.

confess_dain_no_4_ins29.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins29.text: *The School Nurse pretends to organize papers on her desk — but she's turned the same page three times.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins32.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins32.text: *She touches her glasses. Behind them, her eyes are bigger than expected. Eyes that were hidden behind playfulness.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins33.name: School Nurse
confess_dain_no_4_ins33.text: ...Will you still come to the nurse's office after you graduate?

confess_dain_no_4_ins34.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins34.text: *It's not really a question. Her face already fears the answer.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins35.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins35.text: *I meet her eyes. The serious face without any playfulness. This is the first time she's been this unguarded.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins36.name: School Nurse
confess_dain_no_4_ins36.text: Oh, no. It's a weird question, right? A teacher shouldn't be asking a student something like —

confess_dain_no_4_ins38.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins38.text: *The School Nurse freezes. The hand fidgeting with her glasses stops.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins40.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins40.text: *For real. Her confirmation phrase. Today I heard it first.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins42.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins42.text: *A moment of silence. Behind the glasses, her eyes look misty. The lenses are foggy — whether from steam or tears, I can't tell.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins43.name: School Nurse
confess_dain_no_4_ins43.text: *Brightening her tone again, though her voice trembles* Alright then. That wraps up your last consultation. I'll pencil your next visit in for after graduation.

confess_dain_no_4_ins44.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_ins44.text: *The playfulness is back. But under those smiling eyes, there's a trace where something ran.*

confess_dain_no_4_ins46.name: Seoyeon
confess_dain_no_4_ins46.text: *...Next time, I'll be expecting different words*

confess_dain_no_4_nurse_skip.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_nurse_skip.text: *I had my last consultation at the nurse's office this morning. — Her glistening eyes are still stuck in my head.*
